name: AG1
note: Official Foundational Nutrition Partner of the U.S. SailGP Team (ussailgpteam.com, 14 Mar 2025). Left unrated for a maintainer: Athletic Greens is a private company founded by Chris Ashenden (ag1-athletic-greens-ownership); its share register isn't public. Its January 2022 round of US$115 million, at a valuation above US$1 billion, was led by Alpha Wave Ventures, the flagship venture fund of Alpha Wave Global, whose chairman Rick Gerson joined the board (Athletic Greens release, Business Wire, 2022-01-25, https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220125005425/en/Athletic-Greens-Raises-%24115M-From-Alpha-Wave-Ventures-and-Strategic-Investors-to-Accelerate-Global-Growth-and-Reach-Millions-of-New-Customers). The same day Abu Dhabi's Chimera Capital closed the US$10 billion fund Alpha Wave Ventures II, which it co-manages with Alpha Wave Global; Chimera Capital is part of Royal Group, chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, and the fund's investors are 'local and regional' and unnamed (Reuters via Euronews, 2022-01-25, https://www.euronews.com/next/2022/01/25/chimera-funds). Which Alpha Wave fund holds the AG1 stake, and how large it is, isn't published. Whether a company Sheikh Tahnoon controls privately is a state link is the maintainer's call (see colnago, ihc). No human-rights finding against the company found.
